summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for a crucial home clash against New Mills at Hind Heath Road, with both sides currently level on 6 points after the opening weeks of the season. The fixture promises to be an intense affair as The Bach look to build momentum in what's shaping up to be a competitive campaign. With games coming thick and fast, the team will be looking to make their home advantage count against a rival team in a similar position in the table.
